description: This is a plush, white lounge chair with a matching ottoman. The chair features a high back with two cushioned sections, both adorned with button tufting. It has padded armrests and a generously sized seat cushion, also with button tufting. The ottoman mirrors the chair's design with its own tufted cushion and a distinctive five-pronged base. The entire set appears to be upholstered in a smooth, possibly leather or high-quality faux leather material, giving it a luxurious and comfortable feel. The overall aesthetic is modern and sophisticated, designed for ultimate relaxation.
